title: A pártállam és a személyi kultusz (Totalitarian State & Cult of Personality)
grammar: Authoritarian Mechanics, Totalitarian Discourse & State Terror Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the one-party state and the cult of Mátyás Rákosi after 1949.
I can say what the Five-Year Plan was.
I can say how the propaganda named Rákosi.
I can use six words about the party-state, such as pártállam and személyi kultusz.
